ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left in the figure is triangle LMN, with vertex L above, M at the lower left, and N at the lower right; at angle M it is labeled (y+10)°. On the right is triangle QRS, with vertex Q below, S at the upper left, and R at the upper right; at angle R it is labeled (2y−40)°. The problem gives triangle LMN congruent to triangle QRS. Reasoning: From the vertex order of the congruence LMN ↔ QRS, it can be known that L ↔ Q, M ↔ R, N ↔ S. Therefore the corresponding angles ∠M and ∠R are equal. According to the labels in the figure, y+10 = 2y−40. Solve the equation: 10 = y−40, so y = 50.
